title: Members WordPress plugin by MemberPress 3.2.28 before 3.3.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that…
description: The Members WordPress plugin by MemberPress versions 3.2.28 up to but not including 3.3.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated visitors to bypass Private Site mode by exploiting a login page exemption. Attackers can use a crafted request with a pagename query variable to access hidden published pages or the full blog index that should be restricted.
